cs.t: I really like the Bose ie2 earbuds  http://www.amazon.com/Bose-627476-0020-IE2-audio-headphones/...  While Bose is generally overpriced, these earbuds are the best I've found in the sub $100 range. The pair i bought has lasted 2 years despite my abusive use (shoving them in my pockets, tossing them around). And I like the sound almost as much as my overear Grados
cs.th: Ask HN: What earbuds do you use? I need help

cs.t:
Bose IE2 for earbuds that I use with my phone and laptop.
Roccat Kave headset for my desktop headset.
